decision_interval: Closed H1; observed M1 execution, completed H4 where needed
entry: Training-only mean next-hour return by asset and Moscow hour; at least60 training observations in a cell. Trade its sign only if absolute forecast >1.5 times estimated round-trip costs
entry_cancel: No positive-volume M1 within5 minutes after requested entry
Entry after main-session expiry for S2
Median prior20 H1 volume implies less than one whole contract at1% participation
exit: First available eligible quote60 minutes after entry, or1.5ATR stop/2R target; hourly coefficients frozen for each subsequent test fold
maximum_hold: S0 five calendar days; S1 twentyfour hours; S2 session end; S3/S5 sixty minutes after actual entry; S4 next eligible daily decision; roll and fold end override
name: Временной эффект внутри дня
overnight: Allowed only for S0/S1/S4; no fabricated fill through an unobserved interval
reference_stop: Signal close -direction*1.5ATR14, rounded to explicitly assumed native tick
reference_target: 2R from reference, except S1 frozen prior20 mean
risk: Common price-book1R planned loss per accepted trade, at most one position per asset/twoR total; not a capital return
roll: Frozen original contract windows, expiry>=9days; exit at expiry-8days; never stitch prices across contract codes
trading_hours: Common entries: weekdays10:00<=entry<19:00MSK, excluding API calendar off-days; source observed bars and protective exits may be outside these hours
